mapper.select: { call GET_MAIN_RANKING(#{period, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}, #{result, jdbcType=CURSOR, mode=OUT, resultMap=top10ResultMap}) }

WITH top10_ids AS ( -- TOP10 키워드 ID를 먼저 구해서 ANTI JOIN으로 제외 (인덱스 활용) SELECT keyword_id FROM ( SELECT kds.KEYWORD_ID, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND kds.KEYWORD_ID NOT IN (SELECT keyword_id FROM top10_ids) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

WITH top10_ids AS ( SELECT keyword_id FROM ( SELECT kds.KEYWORD_ID, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-06-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-06-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND kds.KEYWORD_ID NOT IN (SELECT keyword_id FROM top10_ids) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

WITH top10_ids AS ( SELECT keyword_id FROM ( SELECT kds.KEYWORD_ID, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND kds.KEYWORD_ID NOT IN (SELECT keyword_id FROM top10_ids) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ( SELECT TOP10.KEYWORD_NAME FROM ( SELECT k2.KEYWORD_NAME FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds2 JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON kds2.KEYWORD_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds2.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds2.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds2.KEYWORD_ID, k2.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) TOP10 WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE() ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT NVL(kds.DAILY_COUNT, 0) as daily_count FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - LEVEL + 1 as stats_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{days} ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kds.STATS_DATE, kds.DAILY_COUNT FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE k.KEYWORD_NAME = #{keyword} AND kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - #{days} + 1 AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) kds ON dates.stats_date = kds.STATS_DATE ORDER BY dates.stats_date ASC

WITH top10_ids AS ( SELECT keyword_id FROM ( SELECT kds.KEYWORD_ID, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days} AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days} AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND kds.KEYWORD_ID NOT IN (SELECT keyword_id FROM top10_ids) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

WITH top15_ids AS ( SELECT keyword_id FROM ( SELECT kds.KEYWORD_ID, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30 AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 15 ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds /*+ INDEX(kds IX_KDS_DT_KW_CNT) */ JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30 AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND kds.KEYWORD_ID NOT IN (SELECT keyword_id FROM top15_ids) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT seq_no AS rank, keyword_name AS name, total_count AS count, '↔' AS trend, CASE WHEN seq_no = 1 THEN '#e60000' WHEN seq_no <= 3 THEN '#ff6600' WHEN seq_no <= 7 THEN '#000000' ELSE '#0044ff' END AS color FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) DESC) AS seq_no, keyword_name, SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) AS total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS WHERE keyword_name IS NOT NULL AND daily_count > 0 GROUP BY keyword_name ) ORDER BY seq_no
